column4: not a look word, it is the brief's question; the game answers it by putting each question inside a buy or a defuse moment, never on a separate quiz screen

column5: Look: bright, chunky low-poly arena — clean blocky shapes, soft sunlight, orange attackers and teal defenders, big painted **A** and **B** floor letters at the bomb sites; flat-coloured crates, walls and doorways with darker edges; the question card is a large high-contrast panel that slides up over the view; signature detail: the bomb's lights flash red and the timer ticks louder on a wrong defuse answer. Every figure drawn, no emoji, no plain circles. *(provisional)*
References: Counter-Strike (attack/defend rounds, buy phase, two bomb sites, economy — not its name, maps, art or UI).
View: 3D · Camera: first-person, gun visible lower right *(provisional)*
Session screen: pick subject and contents, or upload a CSV of questions (question, 4 choices, correct answer)

Built-in question bank: Math (arithmetic, multiplication tables, fractions, simple equations) generated so it never runs out, plus Science, Geography and English vocabulary banks for ages 10–14 *(provisional)*
Buy menu in each base: every item asks a multiple-choice question; a wrong answer swaps in a new question
Defuse = a multiple-choice question under the bomb timer; a wrong answer swaps in a new question while the timer runs
Team of 4 vs 4 (you + 3 bot teammates vs 4 bots, named as bots) with 3 bot roles: rusher (SMG), rifleman (holds middle distance), sniper (holds long lanes); bots buy on their own
Ammo and reload: magazine and reserve beside health and armour; an empty gun clicks
Mouse-look with sensitivity setting, hit markers, distinct guns (pistol, SMG, rifle, sniper), hurt direction marker
One original map with two bomb sites (A and B), two bases, 3 lanes
Round flow: buy phase, round timer, plant/defuse, money rewards, halftime swap, final score with each player's questions right/wrong

The menu opens on a session screen: pick a subject (Math preselected) and its contents (e.g. multiplication + fractions), or upload a CSV.
Press Start.
You spawn in the attacker base with 3 bot teammates; a 20-second buy phase; a hint says "Press B to buy".
You click the SMG — a question card with 4 choices appears; right answer, chime, the SMG is in your hands.
A wrong pick on ammo: the card shakes and a new question replaces it.

The doors open; you push toward site A with your team, trade first shots with defender bots, and plant by holding E — if a defender bot reaches the bomb, you watch its defuse bar stall as it "thinks".
Round 1 is fair: everyone on pistols, bots react slowly.
By round 3 the bots have bought rifles and the sniper bot holds long lanes, so every buy question matters.
A lost round costs money — smaller budget, fewer questions' worth of gear next round — never the match.
At halftime sides swap and on defence you must answer the defuse question before the 40-second bomb timer runs out.
*(provisional)*
